title: Product Import & Export
description: Learn how to import products from CSV files and export products for backup or migration purposes.
content:
Product Import & Export

Import and export products using CSV files to manage large catalogs, migrate data, or backup your products.

Exporting Products

Step 1: Access Export

Navigate to Products → Export or use the Export button on the Products page.

Step 2: Configure Export

Select what to export:

  • All products
  • Filtered products (apply filters first)
  • Specific products (select products first)
  • Include/exclude fields

Step 3: Download CSV

Click "Export" to download a CSV file containing your products.

CSV File Format

The exported CSV includes columns for:

  • Product name
  • SKU
  • Description
  • Price
  • Sale price
  • Stock quantity
  • Categories
  • Images
  • Attributes
  • Variants
  • SEO fields
  • And more

Preparing Import File

Before importing, prepare your CSV file:

  • Use the export template as reference
  • Fill in required fields (name, price, SKU)
  • Use correct format for dates, numbers
  • Separate multiple values with commas or pipes
  • Use proper image URLs or paths
  • Validate data before importing

Importing Products

Step 1: Access Import

Navigate to Products → Import.

Step 2: Upload CSV File

Select your CSV file and upload it. Maximum file size is typically 10MB.

Step 3: Map Columns

Map your CSV columns to product fields:

  • Automatic mapping for standard columns
  • Manual mapping for custom columns
  • Skip columns you don't want to import

Step 4: Import Settings

Configure import options:

  • Update Existing: Update products with matching SKU
  • Skip Existing: Skip products that already exist
  • Create New: Always create new products
  • Default Status: Set status for imported products
  • Default Category: Assign default category

Step 5: Validate & Import

Preview and validate the import:

  • Review validation results
  • Fix any errors
  • Confirm the number of products to import
  • Click "Import" to proceed

Import Options

Update Existing Products

Update products that match by SKU or name. Useful for:

  • Updating prices
  • Updating inventory
  • Updating descriptions

Create New Products

Always create new products, even if SKU matches. Useful for:

  • Initial product import
  • Duplicating products

Skip Duplicates

Skip products that already exist. Useful for:

  • Importing only new products
  • Avoiding overwriting existing data

Handling Images

Import images using:

  • URLs to external images
  • File paths (if uploading images separately)
  • Base64 encoded images (for small catalogs)
  • Multiple image URLs separated by commas

Import Errors

Common import errors and solutions:

  • Missing Required Fields: Ensure name, price, and SKU are present
  • Invalid Format: Check date, number, and price formats
  • Duplicate SKUs: Ensure SKUs are unique or use update mode
  • Invalid Categories: Create categories before importing
  • Large File: Split large files into smaller batches

Best Practices

  • Always backup before importing
  • Test import with a few products first
  • Validate CSV data before importing
  • Use consistent formatting
  • Keep SKUs unique
  • Review import preview carefully
  • Import in batches for large catalogs
